card.architecture: FLUX.1-dev finetune (Krea, rectified-flow DiT, T5-XXL + CLIP-L), guidance-distilled, whole-image img2img redraw
card.summary: Reinterpret an entire existing image through FLUX.1-Krea using a prompt — the source is used as the init latent and re-sampled at a partial denoise with NO mask, so the composition is kept but the whole frame is redrawn as a natural, un-'AI-looking' photograph. Ideal for pushing an illustration or an over-processed render toward candid realism while keeping its layout.
card.pick_when: You want to redraw the WHOLE image into a natural photograph, keeping the composition. Use FLUX.1-dev instead when you want the stock FLUX look.

prompt.guidance: Describe the photo you want in plain, specific words (subject, setting, lighting, lens, mood). Lower the redraw strength to stay close to the source composition; raise it to let Krea reinterpret more.
prompt.example: A candid 35mm photo of a woman laughing on a sunlit balcony, soft natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, warm afternoon light
prompt.instructions:
Type the FULL description of the picture you want — this is a whole-frame re-render, not an edit instruction, and FLUX.1-Krea follows natural-language prose.
28 steps, euler/simple, distilled guidance 4.5 (real CFG stays 1).
'Redraw strength' (denoise) controls how far the result drifts from the source: ~0.3-0.5 keeps the source's structure and mostly restyles it, ~0.7+ substantially reinvents it.
The source is normalized to the configured ~1 MP working budget with its aspect ratio preserved, so low-resolution inputs gain a larger VAE grid and oversized inputs are reduced before sampling.
Negative prompts are inactive: the model is guidance-distilled and runs at CFG 1.

ui_help.note: Send an image + a photo description; the whole frame is redrawn through FLUX.1-Krea. 'Redraw strength' controls how far it drifts from the source.
ui_help.good_for: redrawing a whole image as natural, realistic photography while keeping its composition

edit_use_cases: whole-image img2img: redraw an entire image as natural photography through FLUX.1-Krea, keeping composition
